categories.main_business_segments: FOOD & LIFE COMPANIES operates four main business segments: Domestic Sushiro (conveyor-belt sushi restaurants in Japan), Overseas Sushiro (international conveyor-belt sushi restaurants), Kyotaru (take-out sushi and traditional sushi restaurants), and Domestic Sugidama (sushi izakaya pubs). The company manages these businesses through a holding company structure, with each segment operated by dedicated subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes high-quality, fresh ingredients, centralized procurement, and in-store preparation as core strengths. It utilizes proprietary IT systems such as digital ordering via touch panels, AI-driven demand forecasting for inventory and procurement, and the 'Digital Sushiro Vision' for enhanced customer experience. Efficiency and food safety are maintained through standardized operations and rigorous hygiene management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: FOOD & LIFE COMPANIES primarily serves general consumers and families seeking affordable, high-quality sushi and Japanese cuisine. Its main markets are the mass-market casual dining sector, with a focus on both dine-in and take-out customers. The company also targets urban and suburban areas, as well as international markets with growing demand for Japanese food.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates 1,198 stores as of September 2025, with 964 in Japan and 234 overseas. Overseas operations span South Korea, Taiwan, Singapore, Hong Kong, Thailand, mainland China, Indonesia, Malaysia, and the United States, with a strategic focus on East Asia, Southeast Asia, and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: FOOD & LIFE COMPANIES is positioned downstream in the supply chain, directly serving end consumers through its restaurant and take-out outlets. It leverages centralized procurement and logistics but does not engage in primary production or wholesale distribution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continued domestic and international expansion, strengthening existing store profitability, optimizing procurement and labor costs, and enhancing customer experience through digital transformation (DX). The company is also focused on sustainability, food safety, and human capital development, with initiatives in diversity, equity, and inclusion (DE&I), and environmental targets such as CO2 reduction. There is no significant in-house R&D for new technologies, but innovation is pursued in operations and customer engagement.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated from direct sales of food and beverages at company-operated and franchised restaurants, as well as take-out and delivery services. Additional income streams include royalties from franchisees, loyalty programs, and limited e-commerce sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other large conveyor-belt sushi chains such as Kura Sushi, Hama Sushi, and Kappa Sushi, as well as broader casual dining and take-out food providers. FOOD & LIFE COMPANIES is a market leader in Japan's conveyor-belt sushi sector and is rapidly expanding its international presence, differentiating itself through scale, brand recognition, and operational excellence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending September 2025, consolidated revenue reached 429.6 billion yen (approx. $2.9 billion), with operating profit of 36.1 billion yen and net profit attributable to owners of 22.9 billion yen. The company has demonstrated strong growth, with revenue increasing 19% year-on-year and significant expansion in both domestic and overseas markets. The workforce has also grown to over 11,700 employees (excluding nearly 24,000 part-time/temporary staff).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: FOOD & LIFE COMPANIES differentiates itself by offering high-quality, fresh sushi at affordable prices, leveraging in-store preparation, centralized procurement, and digital innovation to enhance customer experience. The company emphasizes food safety, sustainability, and a diverse menu tailored to local tastes, aiming to deliver 'deliciousness every day' and bring joy to customers worldwide.
